title: Umang
tagline: Anantapur Subsection Student Congress under IEEE Hyderabad SAC.
short_description: A flagship student congress for the Anantapur subsection, focused on student leadership, branch collaboration, and IEEE community building.
long_description: Umang is the Anantapur subsection student congress platform under the IEEE Hyderabad Section student activities ecosystem. It brings together student branches, faculty coordinators, IEEE volunteers, and student leaders for learning, networking, and collaborative growth.
highlights: IEEE volunteer and student leader networking
Technical and professional engagement for students
